name: Petrona Morrison
note: Returned to Jamaica for good in 1995; retired as Director of School of Visual Arts, Edna Manley College in 2014; Gold Musgrave Medal 2014; solo show 'New Works' 2019. City not stated.

name: Ras Mosera
note: Self-taught painter, expressionist tending to abstraction; website rasmosera.net (not opened).

name: Kishan Munroe
residence: Washington, USA (one source; unconfirmed, may be Nassau, Bahamas)

works.title: Swan Song of the Flamingo (solo show)

note: Born Nassau (Grants Town); moved to US 2004. Sources conflict on degrees and residence. Represented Bahamas at Liverpool Biennial 2010; long-running project The Universal Human Experience (from 2008).

name: Lavar Munroe
residence: Baltimore, USA / Nassau, Bahamas (sources differ; one says Washington, DC / Nassau)
note: Born Nassau; moved to US 2004. Venice Biennale 2015 (All the World's Futures); Guggenheim Fellow 2023; solo shows Monique Meloche (Chicago) and Jack Bell (London) 2023. No individual work titles seen.

name: Chris Ofili
residence: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
note: Born Manchester of Nigerian descent; in Trinidad since 2005; Turner Prize 1998. Not Caribbean-born.

name: Karyn Olivier

works.title: How Many Ways Can You Disappear

note: Born Port of Spain, raised Brooklyn; Tyler School of Art, Temple University; Whitney Biennial 2024; solo show planned MOCA Detroit 2026.

name: Steve Ouditt

works.title: Creole in-site (book of writings and images)

note: No birth year or residence found. Trinidadian artist-writer; Carifesta panels reported under spelling 'Steve Oudit' (possibly same).

name: Zak Ové
residence: London, UK / Trinidad (most sources); two galleries list Las Palmas, Gran Canaria, Spain
note: Born London; father Horace Ové. First Caribbean artist commissioned by British Museum (2014, pair of 7 m Moko Jumbie sculptures); 40 statues at Somerset House for 1:54 London 2016. Exact work titles not shown in results.

name: Raquel Paiewonsky
note: Born Puerto Plata; Venice Biennale 2009 and 2013; CAAM retrospective 2018; residence from a single source.

name: Jorge Pardo
note: Born Havana, raised Chicago; MacArthur Fellow 2010. Cuban-American, not Caribbean-resident.

name: René Peña
note: Photographer, black-and-white self-portraits on race and identity; solo shows Stories of the City (1991), Burden and Blessing (1998). No individual work titles with year/url seen.

name: Douglas Pérez Castro
note: Born Cienfuegos (one source says Havana). Professor of Painting at ISA Havana per one source; residence not explicitly stated.

name: Marcel Pinas
note: Born 22 March 1971 (Wikimedia Commons). Residence not shown in results; runs programs in Moengo. Afaka-script geometric canvases.

name: Eduardo Ponjuán González
note: Born Pinar del Río; National Prize for Visual Arts 2013; collaborated with René Francisco Rodríguez 1986-96. Residence not stated.

name: Wilfredo Prieto
residence: Havana, Cuba (2020 gallery CV, Ocula); earlier profiles place him in Barcelona
note: Born Sancti Spíritus area; Guggenheim Fellow 2006; monograph Works 1995-2012. No individual work titles seen.

name: Omari Ra
note: Born Kingston; head of Painting Department, Edna Manley College (implies Kingston, not stated). Aaron Matalon Award 2004.

name: Sandra Ramos
note: Born Havana; MFA San Francisco Art Institute; Venice Biennale 2013.

name: Dhiradj Ramsamoedj
note: Teaches in Paramaribo; birth year from Art Zuid only.

name: Richard Mark Rawlins

works.title: Steupps#157 (fifth solo show, Medulla Art Gallery, Port of Spain)

note: Graphic designer and artist; publishes Draconian Switch; collaborates with Alice Yard. Birth year and residence not found.

name: Pippa Ridley
note: Painter/draughtswoman, born in the Caribbean (country not named), schooled in UK, Slade graduate, teaches at Royal Drawing School; shows at Thomas Williams Gallery London. Birth year and residence not stated; likely UK-based.

name: René Francisco Rodríguez
note: Born Holguín; professor at ISA; National Visual Art Award 2010. Madrid base per MFAH/Hans Herzog records.
